name: Rocket Stick 1.2g Rosin Injected Donut - Maui Milky Way
description:
Premium flower meets solventless power. The Rocket Stick Maui Milky Way donut is a 1.2-gram infused pre-roll, hand-crafted and injected with live rosin for an extra-potent, flavor-packed smoke — finished with a smooth glass tip for a clean, comfortable pull. No device, no charging, just spark and go.

Maui Milky Way brings a bright, tropical-sweet flavor: juicy pineapple and mango notes layered with a smooth, creamy finish — all carried by the full-spectrum character of solventless rosin. Because it's infused with real rosin, every pull delivers deeper flavor and a heavier, more well-rounded effect that leans bright and uplifting — smooth, potent, and built to satisfy experienced smokers looking for a flavorful, feel-good session.

Why you'll love it:

1.2G infused pre-roll — quality flower injected with live rosin for extra potency
Solventless rosin — full-spectrum flavor and effect
Glass tip — smooth, clean pulls and a comfortable mouthpiece
Signature Maui Milky Way flavor — juicy tropical pineapple and mango with a creamy finish
Ready to enjoy — no setup, no battery, just light and go

Bold flavor, premium rosin potency, and effortless convenience in one ready-to-smoke donut. Rocket Stick Maui Milky Way is ready whenever you are.
